ownerOnly: This view is only available to owners.
loadFailed: The data could not be loaded.

events.title: Sign-in events
events.description: All events of the sign-in protection. Clicking a pseudonym filters by it – follow a trail from network to account to tenant. Accounts, networks and devices are only shown shortened.
events.resolveConfirm: Map this event's pseudonym to an account? This requires a passkey confirmation and is recorded in the audit log.
events.countrySource: Country data: <link>“IP to Country Lite” by DB-IP.com</link> (CC BY 4.0), looked up locally, no IP address stored.
events.pageInfoKeyset: Page {page, number} · {count, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}} · newest first
events.tokenInvalid: Unknown filter. Possible: account:, network:, device: (at least 4 characters) or country: (e.g. CH).
events.tokenHelp: Press Enter to apply. Clicking a pseudonym in the list filters too.
events.histogramSummary: {failure, number} failed attempts, {other, number} rejected or checked and {success, number} successful events in the selected period.
events.barTitle: {time}: {failure, number} failed · {other, number} rejected/checked · {success, number} successful
events.distribution: {failure, number} failed, {other, number} rejected/checked, {success, number} successful
events.noWeights: Older events (before 1.6) only store the reasons, not the weights.
events.blockDescription: Manual block (stage 5) of this event's network (IPv4 /24, IPv6 /48). Confirmed with a passkey and recorded in the audit log. Platform admins remain exempt.
events.blockShared: This network produced {count, plural, one {# event} other {# events}} within ±{hours} h. A shared network (company NAT, proxy, school) blocks everyone without a known device.

blocks.title: Blocks
blocks.description: Temporary blocks of sources for the sign-in endpoints – never for accounts on known devices, never permanent. A pseudonym is blocked, never an address. Setting, extending and lifting require passkey confirmation.
blocks.unblockConfirm: Lift the block for {subject}? Sign-ins from this source will be possible again.
blocks.ipHelp: Hashed when saved and never stored in plain text.
blocks.readOnly: Only owners can set or lift blocks.
blocks.remainingShare: Remaining share of the block duration
blocks.extendDescription: The block then becomes a manual block (stage 5). Confirmed with a passkey and recorded in the audit log.
blocks.modalDescription: Stage 5. Confirmed with a passkey and recorded in the audit log.
blocks.reasonHelp: Required, e.g. abuse report or incident.

ladder.title: Defence stages
ladder.hint: Stages 1–3: events in the last 24 h · stages 4–5: active blocks

2.title: Limits lowered
2.text: Attempt rate or failure limit exceeded, attempt rejected.

3.title: Extra check
3.text: Unknown devices need an email code or second factor.

4.title: Temporarily blocked
4.text: After repeated hard limits: sign-in endpoints closed for the source.

5.title: Manually blocked
5.text: By a platform admin with reason and expiry.

ladder.durations: Duration per repetition within 7 days: {durations} min
ladder.limits: Automatic at most {automatic} h, manual at most {manual} days

history.title: History, 7 days
history.summary: {sources, plural, =0 {No blocks} one {# source} other {# sources}} with {bars, plural, one {# block} other {# blocks}}, {manual, number} of them manual. Repetitions get longer.
history.empty: There were no blocks in the last 7 days.

alerts.title: Alert rules
alerts.description: Ten rules check the sign-in protection continuously. Per rule: current value against the threshold, history and triggers in the last 30 days. The same rules also notify via ntfy.
alerts.empty: No alert rule is currently triggered.

rules.stuffing: Credential stuffing: many failures from many networks
rules.admin_new_device: Platform sign-in from a new device
rules.tenant: Many accounts of one tenant with failures

alerts.clearsAt: Clears by itself at {time} if nothing new happens until then (window of {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} after the last event).
alerts.noIncident: will be recorded as an incident on the next monitor run
alerts.incidentHelp: Every triggered rule is bundled into exactly one open incident. Set status, assignee and notes under «Incidents».

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Admin and tenant actions with their outcome.

policy.title: Policies
policy.description: Effective settings of the sign-in protection (display only, without secrets). They are changed in the server configuration.

export.title: Export security data
export.description: JSONL file encrypted with your password. The export is confirmed with a passkey and recorded in the audit log.
export.passwordHelp: At least {min} characters. The file cannot be opened without this password.

subject.title: Account for this event
subject.description: The lookup has been recorded in the audit log. Network and address are never shown.
subject.unknown: No account found: the entered address does not belong to any account or the event is too old.
subject.name: Name

viaKinds.related_event: an earlier event with the same pseudonym

conditions.stuffing: At least {threshold} failed attempts (max. of minimum and factor × usual rate) from many networks in {minutes} minutes. Switches on attack mode.
conditions.spraying: At least {threshold} different accounts are tried from one network with a wrong password in {minutes} minutes.
conditions.account_attack: At least {threshold} failed attempts on one account from several networks in {minutes} minutes. Critical for accounts with admin rights.
conditions.admin_mfa: At least {threshold} wrong MFA codes of a platform admin in {minutes} minutes.
conditions.admin_new_device: A platform admin signs in from an unknown device (window {minutes} minutes).
conditions.network: At least {threshold} failed attempts from one network (IPv4 /24, IPv6 /48) in {minutes} minutes.
conditions.cross_tenant: Failed attempts from one network against at least {threshold} tenants in {minutes} minutes.
conditions.tenant: At least {threshold} different accounts of one tenant with failed attempts in {minutes} minutes.
conditions.limiter: At least {threshold} rate limiter outage in {minutes} minutes. Unknown devices are then rejected.

rules.title: Rules
rules.description: Thresholds are changed in the server configuration and only shown here.
rules.triggered30: {count, plural, one {# × in 30 d} other {# × in 30 d}}
rules.settingsHelp: Notification via ntfy with debouncing and reminder. An alert clears by itself {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} after the last event.
rules.noRecent: Not triggered in the last 30 days.
rules.seriesSummary: Highest value {peak}, threshold {threshold}; {over, plural, =0 {no section} one {# section} other {# sections}} above the threshold (sections of {minutes} minutes).
rules.seriesApprox: Approximation: fixed sections of {minutes} minutes instead of the rule's sliding window.

incidents.title: Incidents
incidents.description: Triggered alert rules, bundled per rule and network, account or tenant. Each incident has a status and an assignee; you confirm every change with your passkey and it is recorded in the audit log.
incidents.sparkLabel: Rule events over the duration of the incident: {values}

detail.statusSaved: Status «{status}» set and recorded in the audit log.
detail.passkeyHint: You confirm changes with your passkey.
detail.participantsHint: Networks, accounts, tenants and countries during the incident (shortened pseudonyms).
detail.noReasons: No risk reasons in this period.
detail.noteHelp: Short and without personal data (no names, addresses or emails).
detail.closeDescription: The incident will be closed. If the rule fires again with a new event afterwards, a new incident is created.
detail.blockDescription: Manual block (stage 5) of this incident's network, IPv4 /24 or IPv6 /48. Platform admins are never blocked. Shared networks (company, school, mobile) affect everyone without a known device.

situation.title: Situation
situation.description: State of sign-in protection across the whole platform. Related warnings are bundled into incidents. Addresses only appear as shortened pseudonyms.

texts.calm: Failed attempts within the usual range, no open incidents.
texts.elevated: {open, plural, =0 {No open incidents} one {# open incident} other {# open incidents}}, {near, plural, =0 {no rule near its threshold} one {# rule near its threshold} other {# rules near their threshold}}.
texts.attack: {critical, plural, one {# critical incident} other {# critical incidents}} open, the rule is still firing. Defences act automatically.
texts.attack_mode: Many failed attempts from many networks: attack mode additionally verifies unknown devices.

kpis.blockedHint: {count, plural, =0 {no active block} one {# active block} other {# active blocks}}

queue.title: Incidents
queue.hint: Open first, then by severity and time.

chart.title: Sign-ins in this period
chart.scaleHint: Square-root scale so background noise stays visible next to peaks · {minutes} min periods · a marker opens the incident

heatmap.title: Failed attempts by weekday and hour
heatmap.summary: Last {days} days: {total} failed attempts, at most {max} in one hour.

rules.title: Alert rules
rules.hint: Current value against the threshold in the rule's window, visible before a rule fires.

countries.title: Origin of failed attempts
countries.hint: {range} · country code from the local GeoIP database, never the address.
countries.empty: No failed attempts in this period.

networks.title: Conspicuous networks
networks.empty: No failed attempts from individual networks.
networks.metaText: {accounts, plural, one {# account} other {# accounts}} · {tenants, plural, one {# tenant} other {# tenants}}

accounts.title: Conspicuous accounts
accounts.empty: No failed attempts on individual accounts.
